units.title: Unit 1: Linear Algebra & Differential Calculus Foundations
units.description: Foundations of linear equations, matrix operations, partial derivatives, and gradient vectors.
learning_goals: Solve system of linear equations using matrix inverse
Calculate partial derivatives of multivariable functions
Analyze learning rate alpha and gradient descent convergence

units.title: Unit 2: Deep Neural Networks & Loss Minimization
units.description: Multi-layer perceptrons, activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid), cross-entropy loss, and backpropagation chain rule.
learning_goals: Derive backpropagation weight updates using chain rule
Compare Binary Cross-Entropy vs Mean Squared Error

units.title: Unit 3: Computer Vision & Transformer Architectures
units.description: Convolutional neural networks, max pooling, feature maps, self-attention mechanisms, and transformer encoders.
learning_goals: Understand spatial convolutions and feature extraction
Apply fine-tuned models to vision and text tasks
